title: Additional-Pair Discount Part for Contact Lenses Bought Outside the Benefit — Vision Plans
content:
**Vision Plans — additional-pair part of the outside-benefit discount rate on contact lenses**

At a participating location, an additional-pair part is added to the outside-benefit discount rate of contact lenses when the person's latest frame meets both of these conditions:
- it carries the paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid remark and is dated on or before the contact lenses; and
- its frame frequency still runs on the date of the contact lenses.

| Latest paid or reimbursed frame of the person | Additional-pair part |
|---|---|
| Dated on or before the contact lenses, frame frequency still running, from the same provider agreement | 10 percentage points |
| Dated on or before the contact lenses, frame frequency still running, from any other provider, participating or not | 5 percentage points |
| No such frame, a frame dated after the contact lenses, or a frame whose frequency has run out | None |

**Which frame is looked at.** The person's latest frame whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid. When that latest frame is the only such service on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none and no earlier frame is looked at. Of several on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.

**When the frame frequency still runs.** The frame frequency is the plan's: 24 months on Cascade Vision Essential 100, Select 130 and Select 150; 12 months on Choice 175 and Premier 200; and 0 on Exam Plus, which has no frame benefit, so it never runs.
- *From-last-service basis:* it still runs when fewer than that many whole calendar months separate the frame's date and the date of the contact lenses.
- *Benefit-year basis:* a 12-month frequency still runs in the frame's own benefit period, and a 24-month frequency in that period and the next.

**Boundary (hypothetical, from-last-service plan with a 24-month frame frequency).** A frame dated 9 September at the same practice: contact lenses on 8 September two years later are 23 whole months later, so 10 percentage points are added. Contact lenses on 9 September two years later are 24 whole months later, and nothing is added.

*Hypothetical figure.* With a materials discount of 20% and a qualifying frame from another practice, contact lenses retailing at 154.60 bought outside the benefit cost the retail charge less 25% of it, which is 115.95.
